As the group spends the next few minutes deciding what to do next, the majority want to leave right away, suddenly a large group of the reptiles fly up and away. Karsemine is able to tell now that they are young drakes. Based on their size five of these would be a tough battle for the group, so it doesn't look good if they are caught fighting the whole nest. Bonogo decides now is a good time to check again on how many remained in the nest.
